extras: Uses a local relay and does not require an official API key.
problem: Manually transferring and formatting notes into X (Twitter) articles is cumbersome.

relations.evidence: The Kaitox Chrome extension picks the draft up on x.com/compose/articles

summary: A companion plugin that previews, styles, and packages the active Obsidian note to create an X (Twitter) Article draft using the Kaitox Chrome extension.
